scope: The April 1978 exterior of the National Arts Theatre in Iganmu, Lagos. Includes the four radial gallery sectors, ramped entrances, glazed roof-terrace rings and distinctive saddle shell over the main auditorium. The modern station, campus additions, interiors and surrounding grounds are outside the model.

review.notes: Qualla was searched first. Its cleared April 1978 White House photo shows an indoor lectern and curtain. No exterior architecture is visible. The original mapped footprint, operator documents and written architectural field report supply the exterior controls. No source image was used.
